facts: Mike Klubnika describes a tabletop horror game with diegetic systems and minimal UI.
The page states the itch.io edition lacks the Steam edition's online leaderboard and multiplayer.
Copyright is attributed to Mike Klubnika; Steam posting is restricted to the named critical_reflex account.
limits: Use developer-authored page text, not visitor comments, as primary evidence.
This is not a permission to redistribute recovered files, a fan port or original game assets.

facts: The official publisher categorizes it as first-person tabletop horror.
Its description identifies a three-round encounter with the Dealer and a shotgun-based variation on Russian roulette.
limits: A press-kit link alone does not establish blanket redistribution, monetization or asset extraction permission.

facts: Godot's official showcase interviews Mike Klubnika about Buckshot Roulette and s.p.l.i.t.
He describes switching from Unity to Godot in late 2023, and names AnimationPlayer and GDScript among the features he likes.
limits: The interview does not identify the exact Godot patch version of the user's installed Buckshot build.
Specific discussion of s.p.l.i.t.'s terminal puzzles must not be misattributed to Buckshot Roulette.

facts: Godot lists Buckshot Roulette by Mike Klubnika in its showcase.
limits: Engine family evidence, not a local-binary version measurement.
